# platform-orchestrator_permissions (Data Source)

Lists the authoritative catalog of permissions assignable to configurable roles.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "platform-orchestrator_permissions" "available" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `permissions` (Attributes List) The permission catalog. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--permissions))

<a id="nestedatt--permissions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `permissions`

Read-Only:

- `category` (String) The permission category.
- `description` (String) The permission description.
- `display_name` (String) The permission display name.
- `id` (String) The exact identifier accepted by a role's permissions set.
- `level` (String) The legacy access level.
- `scopes` (Set of String) The assignment scopes where the permission is effective.
